description: Acme GraphQL schema standards update policy. Composable: contains only packageRules for @acme/eslint-plugin-graphql, so it can be extended alongside a repo's existing Renovate config.

packageRules.description: In-range minors and patches only ever ADD rules as warnings, so they cannot turn a green build red. Safe to merge unattended. rangeStrategy update-lockfile keeps package.json at ^1.x and moves only the lockfile, matching what `npm run update-rules` does by hand.
Majors promote pending rules from warn to error and WILL fail builds that have outstanding warnings. Always requires a human.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **This major promotes pending rules from `warn` to `error`.**
Before merging, run `cd .lint && npm run lint` and clear any remaining warnings — they become build failures on merge.
See the rule reference in `@acme/eslint-plugin-graphql` for which rules were promoted.
